about: [O7 after the critic, B2] the wanted man, idle: I stand 9 m off watching him; he notices ('Looking for me?'), comes and fights; nothing pressed, the crowd brawl's warning first ('One more and you're down.'), then down - the black names him - and up at the hospital (by my car, the stitches paid); he is back on his corner.

he is still out: nothing paid, nothing lost but the stitches
